gaps.g2: Ten parameters stand (the 2026-10-14 ruling, as built on push/vg-p2-fin): om_growth_probe_run(..., int32_t lot_cap) is the tenth; the probe never includes om_internal.h; the script-fixed constant PROBE_LOT_CAP 8192 is passed by the tests and is the value P3 raises OM_LOT_CAP to (om_internal.h:79, 2048 today). Spec :129 gains the tenth parameter.
gaps.g4: Superseded 2026-10-21 by gaps.box: the 119 clause (side 240, core 120) is replaced as ruled there.
gaps.g11: Carry the narrowing. TD-VG-P-1 (scope-narrowed, ages 20 and up asserted; age 10 prints its ratios and asserts nothing; threshold 0.10 untouched) moves to main byte-identical from push/vg-p2-rulings with the Architect's clerk; spec :136 says 'at ages 20 and up (TD-VG-P-1; age 10 printed)'.
gaps.g12: Left-to-right repeated multiplication, ((P * f) * f) * f, cost times, in one shared helper om_field_apply_cost(double v, double f, uint8_t cost) in field_noise.h/field_noise.c (P2's files); the probe calls it and P3's hop calls the same helper, so the parity test compares one arithmetic. No pow.
gaps.g13: One formula everywhere, s = floor_div(tick, 60), negative during pre-growth, no hidden step counter in the sim. The probe's k-th step (k = 1..N) uses s = k - N, so its sequence ends at 0 exactly as pre-growth does for a core of age N (every core's pre-growth ends at tick 0, so a core of age N sees s = -(N-1)..0 whatever max_age is). The parity test (:192) drives the sim at ticks (k - N) * 60 for k = 1..N, the pre-growth ticks, not 60 * k: that tests the path the game uses. Spec :115 and :192 are corrected to say so.
gaps.active: A source i leaves the active list at step s only when every one of its eight neighbour hops was attempted at step s with its gate open (floor_mod(s, cost[j]) == 0) and none was accepted; a source with any gate-closed neighbour at step s stays queued. Gates of cost 1, 2 and 3 all open within any 6 consecutive steps, so a source lives at most 6 steps past its last accepted hop; no per-source state beyond the list. (Architect 2026-10-21; the spec's earlier rule, under which a gate-blocked source left the list, starved the front at step 1: FINDING-p2r-gate-starves-front.) It applies to the probe and to P3's hop alike; the probe comment in field_noise.h states it; spec :136 and the hop paragraph :187 carry it.
gaps.box: Architect 2026-10-21: side 240 is too small for the field (two seeds reach the border at age 150). The field tests move to side 400, core (200, 200). The east-ray clause becomes: the farthest east-ray cell with P > 0 lies strictly inside the box (reach under 199 cells, printed, measured at age 150 and at age 400). The death-step test runs at age 400 (age 150 cannot show a death under the new rule) and keeps DRAFT-death-floor 100 and DRAFT-death-steps 600 (measured 163 to 183, inside). The 0.99^k ring bound is unchanged. If any seed touches 199 the writer reports the number again before changing anything (g4 stands).
gaps.buckets: Architect 2026-10-21: thirds of the fbm span are not thirds of the cells (measured 16/69/15). DRAFT-field-cost-buckets becomes quantile pins: q1 and q2 are the pooled 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles of v_q16 over the 10,000 cells of each of seeds 1 to 64, measured by the probe's pin step and pinned in the source in Q16 beside lo and hi (same slack rule, DRAFT-noise-range-slack 0 to 0.05 of the span). Cost is 3 when v_q16 < q1, 2 when v_q16 < q2, else 1. DRAFT-field-cost-share 15 to 55 is unchanged and now expects about 33 each; the test prints the shares. Integer arithmetic only, as before.
gaps.shares: Architect 2026-10-21: the front assertion against DRAFT-shape-harm 0.5 applies at steps 10 and 20 only; at steps 3 and 5 the reached set is 3 to 12 cells and has no radial profile worth a spectrum, so those two are printed, not asserted (a scope narrowing). Values above 0.5 at steps 10 and 20 and lots at any age, and first-ring spreads under DRAFT-first-ring-spread 2, are Westley's numbers per the spec: the writer reports every seed's value beside the pin to the Architect, they go to Westley with the S-191 shot, and nothing is widened by anyone else. Lot counts age 10 = 86 and age 40 = 600 are as designed (the 0.6 fill binds at 10, the 15-per-age term at 40); the spec's 'about 150' at age 10 was a guess and is corrected to 'about 90, the 0.6 fill binds'.
gaps.control: Architect 2026-10-21: a control that trips through int64 overflow is not a positive control for divergence. The divergence control runs at age 40 on side 400 seed 1 with the patched decays (PROBE_BASE_DECAY and PROBE_NONWATER_FAR at 1.01): assert the ring-bound detector fails (ring-1 maximum above 0.99; measured 4.98e5) and the death step is -1 at age 40 (measured); one age, both halves kept, 30 steps before the overflow. The real divergence test stays at age 400 as GAP 3 ruled (decay below 1 keeps P bounded by its initial sum, so the Q16 truncation never sees a value outside int64 on the faithful probe; one sentence in the probe comment says so). No overflow-sensitive control.
gaps.order: Architect 2026-10-21: the next active list is built in one pass over the current list in its order; for each source, the cells it activates this step in the hop's neighbour order, then the source itself when it keeps budget ('after its own hops', not 'after the whole step'). The writer re-measures the lots shares under this rule on every seed and prints them.
gaps.lotsscope: Architect 2026-10-21: the lots harmonic share (DRAFT-shape-harm 0.5, unchanged) is asserted at ages 20 and later and printed at age 10: at age 10 a town has about 86 lots and the 4+8 harmonic share of so few lots follows the list order the bookkeeping rule sets, not the field noise the test is for (a scope narrowing). If any seed reads above 0.5 at age 20 or later under the ruled order, STOP and send the numbers: that is Westley's number.
gaps.sides: Architect 2026-10-21: side 400 (core (200,200)) is for the field tests (reach and death at age 400); the shape, first-ring, front, lots and determinism tests stay at side 240 core (120,120), where the probe's pins were measured. The spec says which tests run at which side.
